excluded: fast retransmit/recovery, limited transmit, idle restart, ECN, SACK/NewReno
FIN-only congestion response and control-byte congestion credit
universal output/timing or implementation refinement proof

CC-WINDOW.interpretation: RFC5681 September2009 sections2/3.1: new data bounded by min(cwnd,rwnd). One SMSS=4 conservative IW; configurable 4..16. SYN/SYNACK acknowledgments do not grow cwnd.

CC-GROWTH.interpretation: Section3.1 eq(2): slow-start increment min(newly acknowledged data bytes,SMSS). At cwnd>=ssthresh use acknowledged-byte counting; on reaching pre-ACK cwnd add one SMSS and reset credit to zero conservatively. No growth for invalid/old/duplicate/control-only ACKs or zero-window/persist probe epochs.
CC-GROWTH.strength: explicit finite slow start and byte-counting congestion avoidance

CC-LOSS.interpretation: Section3.1 eq(4): first actual positive-window data timeout for oldest byte sets ssthresh=max(floor(FlightSize/2),2*SMSS), cwnd=SMSS. Repeated timeout of that byte preserves ssthresh. Per-byte timeout marks shift with actual acknowledged data; zero-window probes and early-wait timer firings do not count as congestion loss.

CC-SOURCE.interpretation: Module-local official RFC version and raw-byte SHA256 binding; the existing global source manifest and old profiles are unchanged.

CC-SCOPE.interpretation: Finite developer overlay, no fast retransmit/recovery, limited transmit, idle restart, ECN or complete TCP claim. FIN/SYN control retains parent sequence/timer semantics; only data bytes earn congestion credit. Persist probe ownership remains explicit and excluded from congestion loss/growth.
